title: Jingle jaunted jingling.
html_source: These sounds occur later on in the Sirens episode as the events to which they belong occur. Joyce prepares us in this initial, apparently random, section of the episode. When we come across the sounds again, via the simple device of familiarity, we are placed at the scene through the medium of sound. It is modernist experiencing of events rather than the reading a plot.

anchor.prefix:
a call, pure, long and throbbing. Longindying call. 

 Decoy. Soft word. But look! The bright stars fade. O rose! Notes chirruping answer. Castile. The morn is breaking.
